EU_AI_ACT.reasoning: Step 1 analysis: The AI system does not exhibit any prohibited practices such as social scoring, real-time biometric mass surveillance, subliminal manipulation, or exploitation of vulnerable groups. Step 2 analysis: The system's purpose is to predict the probability of loan default and evaluate creditworthiness using applicant transaction history and credit bureau data. According to Annex III, point 5(b), AI systems intended to be used to evaluate the creditworthiness of natural persons or establish their credit score are classified as HIGH_RISK. Furthermore, Article 6 confirms that profiling natural persons in the context of Annex III use cases maintains high-risk status. Article 19 also applies specific obligations regarding automatically generated logs for high-risk AI systems deployed by financial institutions.
